============================================================================
OmniBuf-PHP Benchmark Suite (PHP 8.6.0 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (365B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 313 ns | 3,196,328 | 365 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 4,638 ns | 215,612 | 365 | 14.82x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 11,166 ns | 89,561 | 365 | 35.67x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 433 ns | 2,309,239 | 341 | 1.38x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 88,290 ns | 11,326 | 341 | 282.08x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 1,427 ns | 700,772 | 803 | 4.56x slower |

### 2. Full Message Decode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 1,002 ns | 997,839 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 16,274 ns | 61,447 | 16.24x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 26,207 ns | 38,157 | 26.15x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 3,720 ns | 268,837 | 3.71x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 55,913 ns | 17,885 | 55.80x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 4,383 ns | 228,179 | 4.37x slower |

### 3. Read a Single Nested Field

### 5. Large Embedded Message Encode

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 853 ns | 1,172,047 | 39255 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 8,968 ns | 111,511 | 39255 | 10.51x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 17,380 ns | 57,537 | 39255 | 20.38x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 2,195 ns | 455,510 | 39227 | 2.57x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,177,080 ns | 850 | 39227 | 1379.93x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 24,784 ns | 40,348 | 39681 | 29.06x slower |

### 6. Embedded Message Growth

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
